sql_query:
SELECT
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
  CAST(MAX(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) AS DATE) AS order_delivered_carrier_date,
  CAST(MAX(o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS DATE) AS order_delivered_customer_date,
  ABS(
    (CAST(MAX(o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS DATE) - CAST(MAX(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) AS DATE))
  ) AS delivery_time_days
FROM
  orders o
WHERE
  o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10)
HAVING
  CAST(MAX(o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS DATE) IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(MAX(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) AS DATE) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  order_delivered_carrier_date;
